launch-tn-memphis-shelby-farms-park.cost: Greenline access is free; bike rentals and other park activities are separately priced.
launch-tn-memphis-shelby-farms-park.hours: The Greenline is open daily from sunrise to sunset, 365 days a year; emergency, storm, construction, or maintenance closures override normal access.
launch-tn-memphis-shelby-farms-park.needToKnow: This pin marks the Greenline inside Shelby Farms Park, not a universal trailhead. Choose an access point and return plan before leaving. Keep right, pass predictably, leash dogs in hand, and expect a long exposed route between facilities.

launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.summary: Old Forest State Natural Area protects 126 acres of Overton Park's old-growth forest and has a numbered interpretive loop plus natural-surface trail connections.
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.cost: Forest and trail access are free.
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.hours: Use the forest only during Overton Park's dawn-to-dusk hours and obey posted weather, trail, habitat, or maintenance closures.
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.needToKnow: Download the official interpretive map before entering. Trails can be rooted, muddy, uneven, and confusing at junctions; stay on marked paths, carry water, and leave plants and wildlife undisturbed.

launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.needToKnow: Navigate to the Shell rather than the general park pin. Event setup can change parking, lawn access, restrooms, security, and permitted items, so check the specific event page before arriving.

launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.name: Doughboy World War I Statue
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.summary: The Doughboy World War I Statue is a named memorial at Veterans Plaza in Overton Park's western cultural landscape.
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.cost: No separate admission is listed for viewing the outdoor memorial.
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.hours: Outdoor viewing follows Overton Park's dawn-to-dusk hours unless an event, ceremony, maintenance project, or closure restricts the plaza.
launch-tn-memphis-overton-park.needToKnow: Use the exact Veterans Plaza pin rather than a zoo or museum entrance. Keep the memorial approach clear and treat inscriptions, commemorative objects, and ceremonies respectfully.

launch-tn-memphis-tom-lee-park.summary: Tom Lee Memorial marks the Mississippi River rescue story for which the park is named and sits within the long riverfront landscape.
launch-tn-memphis-tom-lee-park.cost: No separate admission is listed for the outdoor memorial or general park access.
launch-tn-memphis-tom-lee-park.hours: Outdoor access follows Tom Lee Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-10:00 p.m. schedule; festivals, river conditions, maintenance, or event fencing can alter access.
launch-tn-memphis-tom-lee-park.needToKnow: The park is long and linear, so use the memorial pin rather than the general riverfront marker. The historic photograph identifies the memorial but the surrounding park was substantially rebuilt; rely on the current map for arrival.

launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.name: Big Rock
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.summary: Big Rock is a well-known family and picnic destination beside Beargrass Creek in Cherokee Park, away from the broad central park pin.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.cost: General access to Big Rock and the surrounding public park area is free.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.hours: Access follows Cherokee Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. hours, subject to high water, storm damage, maintenance, and road closures.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.needToKnow: Navigate directly to Big Rock and use legal nearby parking. Supervise children beside the creek and on rock surfaces; water depth, current, footing, and contamination can change after rain.

launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.name: Hogan's Fountain
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.summary: Hogan's Fountain is Cherokee Park's historic sculptural fountain near the pavilion, sprayground, Scenic Loop, and developed recreation area.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.cost: No separate admission is listed for viewing the outdoor fountain.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.hours: Outdoor access follows Cherokee Park's daily 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. hours; fountain operation and nearby facilities can be seasonal or paused for maintenance.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.needToKnow: The fountain is an ornamental landmark, not the park's sprayground. Route to Hogan's Fountain when meeting here and check posted signs before assuming water is operating.

launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.name: Hogan's Fountain Pavilion
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.summary: Hogan's Fountain Pavilion is the distinctive covered gathering structure near the fountain and sprayground in Cherokee Park.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.cost: Walking through the public area is free; exclusive use, organized gatherings, and permits can require a reservation and fee.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.hours: The pavilion area follows park hours, 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m.; reservations, maintenance, and private permitted use can limit availability.
launch-ky-louisville-cherokee-park.needToKnow: An empty table does not guarantee the pavilion is unreserved. Check Louisville's reservation system for planned gatherings and use the exact pavilion pin to avoid circling the one-way Scenic Loop.

launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.name: Big Four Bridge
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.boundaryExceptionReason: The official Waterfront Park destination extends from its in-park ramp over the Ohio River beyond the mapped land polygon.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.summary: Big Four Bridge is the paved pedestrian and bicycle crossing from Louisville Waterfront Park over the Ohio River to Jeffersonville, Indiana.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.cost: Walking and bicycling across the bridge are free; nearby parking, food, rentals, and events can charge separately.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.hours: Use the bridge only during currently posted park and bridge access hours; severe weather, maintenance, emergency response, or events can temporarily close the ramp or deck.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.needToKnow: The long spiral ramp adds substantial distance and climbing before the river crossing. The deck is exposed to sun, wind, heat, and cold, so carry water and plan for the full out-and-back distance or an Indiana-side return.

launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.name: Adventure Playground
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.summary: Adventure Playground is the family play area at 1101 River Road beside the seasonal Splash Park and east of the Big Four Bridge.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.cost: Adventure Playground and seasonal Splash Park access are free; parking, vendors, rentals, and events may charge separately.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.hours: Adventure Playground is listed 6:00 a.m.-11:00 p.m. The adjacent Splash Park is scheduled 11:00 a.m.-8:00 p.m. May through October, subject to weather and maintenance.
launch-ky-louisville-louisville-waterfro.needToKnow: Use the Silver parking lot for this playground and Splash Park. It is distinct from the Children's Play Area and PlayPort, so confirm the destination before parking and check water-feature status on hot days.

launch-ky-louisville-iroquois-park.name: North Scenic Overlook
launch-ky-louisville-iroquois-park.summary: North Scenic Overlook is the high viewpoint in Iroquois Park with long views toward Louisville and limited scheduled vehicle access.
launch-ky-louisville-iroquois-park.cost: Overlook access is free; ticketed park events and other facilities may charge separately.
launch-ky-louisville-iroquois-park.hours: Pedestrian access follows posted park and trail conditions. Louisville lists selected 2026 vehicle-access weekends from March through November, generally 10:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m. Saturday and 11:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m. Sunday; recheck the live schedule.
launch-ky-louisville-iroquois-park.needToKnow: Do not assume you can drive to the overlook. Outside posted vehicle-access windows, expect an uphill approach on foot and plan for heat, grade, weather, and the return descent.
